assets.name: forest
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: seamless pixel-art terrain motif for a Game Boy shooting game, single square repeating border block.
Primary request: A lush conifer treetop and visible dark tree trunk, a small round bush and path stones. Top-down forest edge at night. Palette very dark navy, forest green, lighter moss green, muted pale leaf highlights.
Composition: one cohesive 32 by 32 logical pixel tile motif filling the square. Export displayed at 1024 by 1024 with crisp exact 32x nearest-neighbor pixel blocks. Entire image contains only a 32x32 logical pixel grid. No subdivisions, no frame, no margins, no text, no labels, no characters.
Style: actual very low resolution 1990s Game Boy pixel art. Bold readable silhouette; 4 flat colors only, no gradients, no antialiasing, no dithering, no tiny noisy texture. Simple large shapes understandable at 32x32. Darker than the player and bullets. Seamless dark edge color suitable for repeating vertically as a narrow 32px-wide stage border. Orthographic top-down view.
